prompt: Which statements about labels are true? Choose all that apply.
explanation: Labels classify and filter, with a default set out of the box; deadlines live on milestones, not labels. Creating or editing labels requires write access — visitors cannot redefine your taxonomy.

options.text: Labels classify issues and pull requests
You can filter issue lists by label
Repositories ship with default labels like `bug` and `enhancement`
Anyone can create labels in any repository
Labels can set a due date on an issue
